title: If It Rains…
intro: If it rains, what will you take?

words.sentence: If it's muddy, I'll wear my boots.
words.def: You wear these tall shoes when it is wet or muddy.

words.sentence: If it's cold, I'll put on my coat.
words.def: You wear this over your clothes when it is cold.

words.sentence: If it snows, I'll wear my gloves.
words.def: You wear these on your hands when it is cold.

parentTip.vi: Trước khi ra ngoài, hỏi con "If it rains, what will you take?" và chờ con trả lời "I'll take my umbrella."
parentTip.say: If it rains, what will you take?

chat.ask: If it snows tomorrow, will you build a snowman?
chat.no: Okay! Maybe you will have a snowball fight?

gaps.s: If it rains, I'll take my ___.
If it's very sunny, I'll wear my ___.
If my hands are cold, I'll put on my ___.
